name: evelynn-postban-race2-g3
description: Evelynn after the bans (no card of its lists is banned): card-level search (lab/deckopt.py) from Jeremy's list of 13 Nov and Dunc's list, against the field without the cards banned on 23 Nov 2026 (Kai'Sa 51, Kennen 44, the two post-ban Riven frames 20 each, Master Yi 16, Rek'Sai 10, Akali 8, Volibear 8; lists patched by lab/tools/postban.py). Exploration and races with the cheap pilot (sims=4, worlds=2), confirmation with the full one. Jeremy, 13 Nov: 'focus sur Evelynn, Volibear et Mordekaiser'. The Evelynn pilot (spec_evelynn_018_v0) trained 18 iterations on Dunc's list only: every card of Jeremy's list that Dunc does not play is new to it, so the table of this search says how the cards do under a weak pilot; no training on Evelynn until Jeremy says so. Stage race2: 6 lists on the same seeds, 9600 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Riven Shattered (post-ban frame) 1084 games, Riven Deserter (post-ban frame) 1084 games, Master Yi (PCQ, post-ban) 868 games.
